meta.title: Train a LoRA with core nodes
meta.about: The path our Train page uses, in six nodes.
needs: An SD 1.5 checkpoint in models/checkpoints (we used v1-5-pruned-emaonly). Any SD 1.5 file works; pick yours in the loader.

A folder of pictures with matching .txt captions in ComfyUI's input folder. We ship one: copy studio/datasets/university_astrolabe (six 512x512 pictures of an invented brass astrolabe that our own SD 1.5 lessons drew, each with a caption) into ComfyUI's input folder under the same name. For your own LoRA, put your pictures and captions in a folder there and pick it instead.

notes.2: Pairs each picture with its caption.
notes.3: Encodes pictures to latents and captions to conditioning, once, ahead of training.
notes.4: The training loop. Rank sets the file size. It needs a free GPU.
